name: codebee-desktop
description: CodeBee desktop preview for Windows, macOS, and Linux
author: CodeBee

scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:runtime:win && electron-builder --config electron-builder.win-compatible.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:win7: npm run prepare:runtime:win7 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.win7.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:universal: npm run prepare:runtime:mac:universal && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare:runtime:linux && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb rpm --x64 --publish never
